author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수천 마리
summary: 산림과 숲 가장자리, 개활지에서 흔히 볼 수 있는 텃새이다. 덤불 사이, 계곡 물가의 바위, 벼랑, 집 처마 밑 등을 뒤지며 먹이를 찾고, 곤충을 주로 먹으며 거미도 먹는다. 5~8월에 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 전국에 살고, 국외에서는 유라시아 전역에 분포한다.

art.subject: Eurasian Wren (Troglodytes troglodytes), adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korea along forest streams and edges: upperparts warm rufous-brown, finely barred darker on the wings and tail, with a row of small pale spots on the wing coverts; faint narrow buff supercilium; underparts paler buff-brown, finely barred dark on the flanks, belly and undertail coverts. Bill thin, pointed, slightly decurved, dark with a paler base. Dark eye. Pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: hopping over a rock beside a mountain stream, searching for insects
art.scene: Korean forest edge beside a rocky mountain stream with shrubs and a low cliff; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a rock with tail cocked: rufous-brown plumage finely barred on wings, tail and flanks, faint pale supercilium, short thin pointed bill, short upright tail
adult, rear three-quarter view on a rock: barred rufous-brown back and wings, very short cocked tail, round body
art.build: Tiny, round, dumpy bird, about 10cm, smaller than a sparrow; big-headed and short-necked. Bill thin, shorter than the head, slightly down-curved. Legs sturdy and fairly long for its size, pinkish-brown. Wings short and rounded. Tail very short, finely barred, usually cocked straight up. Moves like a mouse among rocks, roots and tangles, often bobbing.
avoid: Do not paint a long tail held level; the tail is very short and usually cocked.
Do not paint streaks or spots on the breast like a sparrow; the markings are fine bars.
Do not paint a thick finch-like bill.
Do not paint grey or olive tones; the bird is warm rufous-brown.
